parameters.name: bundle_members
parameters.description: Asset indices contained in each inseparable bundle

variables.name: asset_assignment
variables.description: Whether asset i is allocated to recipient r

variables.name: bundle_assignment
variables.description: Whether bundle b is allocated to recipient r

variables.name: recipient_total_value
variables.description: Total value assigned to each recipient

constraints.name: exactly_one_recipient_per_asset
constraints.description: No asset may be split across recipients
constraints.formula: asset assignment is binary and exclusive across recipients

constraints.name: bundle_integrity
constraints.description: All members of the same bundle must be allocated together to the same recipient
constraints.formula: all assets in a bundle share one recipient assignment

constraints.name: recipient_total_value_definition
constraints.description: The allocation is single-period and has no time horizon index
constraints.formula: no time index is used in the model

constraints.name: value_imbalance_definition
constraints.description: The imbalance measure equals the maximum difference between any recipient total values.

constraints.name: bundle_assignment_consistency
constraints.description: Each bundle is assigned to exactly one recipient, and this assignment matches the common recipient of all assets in the bundle.

constraints.name: exactly_one_recipient_per_asset
constraints.description: Each asset must be assigned to exactly one recipient

constraints.name: bundle_integrity
constraints.description: If an asset belongs to bundle b, it must be assigned to the same recipient as that bundle

constraints.name: recipient_total_value_definition
constraints.description: The total value for each recipient equals the sum of the values of all assets assigned to that recipient

constraints.name: imbalance_absolute_gap_definition
constraints.description: The imbalance measure is at least the absolute difference between every pair of recipient total values
constraints.formula: \Delta \geq V_r - V_{r'} \quad \forall r=1,\dots,R,\ \forall r'=1,\dots,R\qquad\text{and}\qquad \Delta \geq V_{r'} - V_r \quad \forall r=1,\dots,R,\ \forall r'=1,\dots,R

objectives.name: minimize_value_imbalance
objectives.description: Minimize the value imbalance measure Delta among recipient total values while satisfying assignment and bundle integrity requirements

final_objective.description: Minimize the value imbalance measure Delta, defined as the maximum absolute difference between any pair of recipient total values.
